summary: Independent design review of frozen TASK-0145 spec 1bfb86a7 on base 12f15a3b. The successor preserves TASK-0143 and TASK-0144 failures, including the source-case index byte change, without claiming the first writer is known. Reusing scope._run_git with an inherited per-child GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 environment is the minimal extension to the existing git_context fix; no new abstraction, persistent setting, dependency, guard relaxation or fixture change is planned. Extending the existing real path-collection test with a clean tracked-file stat mismatch and explicit parent optional locks enabled provides meaningful old-source RED/fixed-source GREEN while preserving index inode, mtime and bytes and original rename/deletion assertions. Actual code, behavior and regression-risk facts support REVIEW/V1. The final integrated policy and both source fixes remain the delivery subject; strict original failure cases, independent reachable-Git audit, current approvals, full native verify, Gate and current-head required CI remain required. Full verification stays on hold until the specified audit and local evidence are complete. No actionable design findings; this review ran no tests and made no source edits.
